name: Codeguide Starter Fullstack
headline: codeguide-starter-fullstack: AI Agent Boilerplate
short_description: Codeguide Starter Fullstack is a boilerplate for AI coding agents, featuring Next.js 15, TypeScript, and database integration. It enables developers to quickly build modern web applications with authentication and dark mode support, reducing setup time and improving productivity.
author: CodeGuide-dev

sections.overview:
Codeguide Starter Fullstack is a production-ready boilerplate template for building modern web applications with Next.js 15, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL. It includes pre-configured authentication via Better Auth, type-safe database operations with Drizzle ORM, and 40+ shadcn/ui components for rapid UI development. The starter features dark mode support with system preference detection, Tailwind CSS v4 styling, and full Docker support for containerized development and deployment. Developers can eliminate repetitive setup work and focus on building features, with environment configuration, database migrations, and responsive design already implemented.
Rapidly prototype fullstack web applications with AI coding agents
Set up user authentication and database schemas without manual configuration
Build responsive web UIs leveraging pre-configured shadcn/ui components
Deploy containerized applications using Docker and Docker Compose
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/CodeGuide-dev/codeguide-starter-fullstack`
